source: Derived from PKHeX-master.zip (GPL project). This JSON contains factual encounter tables and lock metadata; no GPL code included.

rng_pipeline_summary.pid_generation: PID is formed from two consecutive 16-bit RNG outputs (high then low).
rng_pipeline_summary.ability_generation: Ability slot is determined from the RNG output after the two IV calls (bit0 of the 16-bit output).

pid_reroll_behavior.for_npc_team_members: PID-only reroll loop until nature+gender constraints match; also reroll to avoid shiny (both games). IVs are not part of this loop.
pid_reroll_behavior.for_shadow_xd: PID-only reroll loop to avoid shiny (XD shadow Pokémon are marked Shiny.Never).
pid_reroll_behavior.for_shadow_colo: No anti-shiny reroll for shadow encounters (they are Shiny.Random), except special starter constraints handled separately in MethodCXD.

preadvance_model.shadow_itself: No fixed pre-advances are encoded per species; shadow generation starts at the seed that produces IV1.
preadvance_model.before_shadow: Encounter-specific and variable: depends on which trainer team (TeamLock) precedes the shadow, whether each member was 'seen', and how many PID rerolls were required to satisfy locks / avoid shinies.
preadvance_model.base_frames_per_team_member: NPCLock.FramesConsumed is 7 frames if not seen, 5 if seen.
